subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development; the production pipeline has no HTTPS enforcement
findings.standard: OWASP Transport Layer Security Cheat Sheet — TLS-03
findings.recommendation: Invert the condition so HTTPS is enforced outside Development; for this API prefer listening on HTTPS only or rejecting HTTP with 400 rather than redirecting (DNW-01, DNW-02, TLS-04). If a reverse proxy outside the repository enforces HTTPS, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is not set anywhere in the pipeline
findings.standard: OWASP HTTP Security Response Headers Cheat Sheet — HDR-03
findings.recommendation: Add middleware that sends X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses. If a reverse proxy or CDN outside the repository adds this header, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: About endpoint can return application configuration details without Cache-Control: no-store
findings.standard: OWASP HTTP Security Response Headers Cheat Sheet — HDR-06
findings.recommendation: Send Cache-Control: no-store on responses that include configuration details (e.g. [ResponseCache(NoStore = true, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None)] on About).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: API responses carry no frame-ancestors 'none' / X-Frame-Options or default no-store directive
findings.standard: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet — RST-08
findings.recommendation: Add API-wide headers Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none', X-Frame-Options: DENY and Cache-Control: no-store (RST-07). If a reverse proxy or CDN outside the repository adds these headers, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Swagger UI is enabled in every environment, including production
findings.recommendation: Map Swagger UI (and the OpenAPI document, if not intentionally public) only in Development or behind authorization in production.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: No CORS policy is configured, so the Same Origin Policy applies
strengths.standard: OWASP HTTP Security Response Headers Cheat Sheet — HDR-09

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Controllers declare explicit HTTP method attributes and no XML formatters are registered
strengths.standard: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet — RST-02
